regions.today: A largely bright and sunny morning with plenty of dry weather and light winds. Sunshine will continue into the afternoon, taking the dry weather with it but more cloud will develop later turning the sunshine a little hazy. Light winds and highs of 16 to 18 degrees.
regions.tonight: Becoming cloudy later but it will remain dry. Light southerly breezes and rather humid conditions overnight too with lowest temperatures of 13 to 16 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: A little cloudy and misty in the morning but sunny spells will break through by the afternoon with plenty of dry weather too. Warmer than previous days with highs of 20 to 23 degrees and feeling humid too in just light southwesterly breezes.
